title: WARSAW / A PRIVATE ENQUIRY
briefing: The retained contact amendment names Warsaw and reference WAW-17. Follow this private lead without changing your agency assignment.
arrival: Warsaw. The contact reference leads to a discreet message desk. No agency badge on the counter. No names in the visitors' book.
contactPrompt: The keeper slides a blank card across the counter. "Reference? And please do not write classified. We already have a drawer full of those."

contactChoices.label: JM-041
contactChoices.reply: "A mission number is not a contact reference. Different drawer. Same dust."

contactChoices.label: WAW-17
contactChoices.reply: "That reference is still active. Someone wants to know what you actually found."

contactChoices.label: I was promised pierogi.
contactChoices.reply: "That is not a reference. It is, however, the most reasonable request today."

verificationPrompt: A handwritten question arrives: "What happened to the scheduled route in the missing radio instructions?"

verificationChoices.label: The scheduled route was confirmed.
verificationChoices.reply: The keeper returns the card. "Read your source again. Nobody is charging by the attempt."

verificationChoices.label: Control ordered the alternate approach.
verificationChoices.reply: The keeper folds the answer. "Wait. Quietly is optional, but recommended."

verificationChoices.label: Control confirmed a murder.
verificationChoices.reply: That is not in the reconstructed transcript. An accusation is not a missing instruction.

johnLines: You found the amendment. I was beginning to think the filing system had buried me more effectively than the crash.
Yes. I am John. I arranged my disappearance. Being recorded as dead seemed safer than remaining easy to find.
You have the route change and the retained contact reference. Keep the originals. Someone is going to tell you that you misunderstood them.
I will not give you a convenient name to put in a report. Check my account independently first. Until then, do not disclose this contact.
success: You met John in Warsaw. He confirms arranging his disappearance and asks you to verify his account independently. No perpetrator has been established by this meeting.
